newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end flat ahead of settlement.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end flat ahead of settlement.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished slightly lower on Monday amid mixed sentiment ahead of settlement on Tuesday, dealers said.

"The market is stagnant as investors are unsure about the direction it may take," dealer Ziana Nowsherwan of BMA Capital Management said, adding the index might remain range-bounded on Tuesday in the absence of any market-moving news.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 0.91 point, or 0.01 percent, to close at 1,588.46 with 235 losers and 88 gainers. Adamjee Insurance fell 3.0 rupees to 108. ICI Pakistan rose 0.15 to 24.70. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
